limit > pool length returns the full pool, sorted by id (numeric localeCompare), missing/undefined ids sort as empty string
non-numeric and missing ids sorted then truncated to limit — pins the numeric localeCompare sort exactly
free: sorted easy -> medium -> hard; missing difficulty defaults to medium, unknown difficulty string also falls into the medium bucket
paid: fresh seeded shuffle of the same pool
free: served = all provided (free) seeds, shuffled — no capping logic applies
paid: one pick per seedId (8 groups), shuffled, capped at examSize=5 (min(examSize, seedGroups) = 5)
paid, narrow chapter: 3 seed groups < default examSize (30) -> result length 3, no forced repetition
free, attempted (5) below the floor (10): denominator is the floor, not attempted
free, attempted exactly at the floor (10)
free, attempted (15) above the floor: denominator is attempted
free, attempted = 0: denominator floors to 10, never divides by zero
paid: denominator is served, not attempted
